heading.title: 2025 Impact Report
heading.subtitle: U&I Trivandrum
heading.description: What we did with last year's fundraiser

content.title: Our 4 Centers
content.description: 4 centers across Trivandrum — 60→140 students (2× growth), 65→151 volunteers, 75→117 classes

content.title: Student Kit for Every Child
content.description: Geometry box, notes, drawing book, coloring box, pen, pencil and other important things — we bought kits for 150+ students, giving them tools just like other students

content.title: Onam Celebration
content.description: We celebrated with them through cultural programs, games, and food

content.title: Christmas Celebration
content.description: We gifted kids with personalised gifts for each of them, bringing the Christmas spirit

content.title: Celebrating Together
content.description: Celebrated Onam, Children's Day, and Christmas with joy and laughter

content.title: Essentials Campaign
content.description: Successfully organized campaign to support students with their basic needs

content.title: Donation Drive
content.description: Giving center essentials like bathing soap, detergent soap, and crowd-sourced new clothes and pre-loved dresses for the kids

content.title: Hygiene Kit for Every Child
content.description: We supplied a basic hygiene kit for each kid — brush, tongue cleaner, nail cutter, combo and other essentials. We gamified it in a bingo format so kids use it as a habit.

content.title: Computer Workshop
content.description: Conducted computer workshop for kids to build digital skills

content.title: CMS Center Renovation
content.description: Completed renovation creating a brighter, safer learning environment

content.title: Fans & Lights at CMS
content.description: Fans and lights we bought for the center — the study hall lacked good air circulation and lighting

content.title: Projector at CMS
content.description: Helping students learn with multimedia and screening English movies

content.title: Books & Library
content.description: Books curated by U&I for teaching English based on student's level; we set up a small library with story books and Labor India subscription for higher education students

content.title: Student Counselling
content.description: Provided counselling at Jayamatha and CMS with continued support ongoing

content.title: Physical Fitness
content.description: Installed goal post to promote fitness, teamwork, and confidence

content.title: Sports & Games Tournament
content.description: Tournament we hosted last year for kids. We bought new equipment for cricket and caroms to increase play time and support their mental health

content.title: STEM Experiments
content.description: Conducted hands-on experiments to spark curiosity and innovation

content.title: STEM Workshop
content.description: Hands-on STEM workshop for kids to explore science, technology, engineering and math

content.title: Arduino Workshop
content.description: Arduino workshop introducing kids to electronics and coding

content.title: Interactive Learning
content.description: Introduced fun knowledge games to make learning exciting and engaging

content.title: Board Games for Learning
content.description: Kids playing board games that help with English and educational thinking — Rapid Rumble, Word Power, Chain Letters, Spot It and more to learn in a fun way. Popular among kids!

content.title: Building Relationships
content.description: Understanding each child's dreams and nurturing their strengths

content.title: Our Growth
content.description: From 60 to 140 students — more than 2x growth in one year

content.title: Community Strength
content.description: 151 volunteers and 117 classes — incredible community support

content.title: Tracking Progress
content.description: We keep track of each student's progress — from mapping them to the correct level and identifying knowledge gaps to mid- and final progress of every child

content.title: Academic Success
content.description: 21.16% rise in literacy levels and 22% improvement across all subjects

content.title: Graduation 2025
content.description: We organised a small graduation-like ceremony to celebrate education, gifting them with personalised jerseys for their center with their name and number

content.title: Our Journey Continues
content.description: Every moment creating lasting impact and transformation

content.title: Transformation
content.description: Volunteers grew into leaders. Students grew into confident learners.

ending.title: Looking Ahead
ending.subtitle: Ready to reach more children and create even greater impact
ending.description: With stronger foundations and renewed energy, U&I Trivandrum moves forward. When hearts and hands come together, change truly becomes possible.

contactInfo.message: Join us in making a difference. Every contribution creates lasting change.
